item.description:
Bigger Meet window, per-window sidebar width, cleaner Board cards

  • The Google Meet floating window opens bigger, at 394 by 560 points, so the call grid fits.
  • Resizing the sidebar in one window no longer resizes the sidebar in your other windows. Each window keeps its own width, also after a restart.
  • The "Drop pane here to separate" box is gone from the terminal sidebar. Use Move Out of Split (right-click or Cmd-K) to pull a pane out.
  • Board card names no longer show "Image #1" or "[Pasted text #N]" from your first message.
  • Board AI card names and icons are now off by default. Turn them on in Settings > Board. Your earlier choice is kept.
